header.title: How to Remove a Range Hood in 10 Steps
header.description: This guide provides a step-by-step process for safely removing a range hood from a kitchen. Follow these instructions to disconnect power, remove wiring, and detach the hood, ensuring proper safety precautions are taken.

steps.description: Disconnect the power to the range hood by identifying and turning off the correct circuit breaker.
actions: Turn the fan and light from the range hood on
Have another person turn the circuits off and then on
Locate the circuit breaker that controls the fan and other hood components
Turn the circuit breaker off
Cut the main power source to the house (if circuit breaker cannot be located)

steps.description: This step instructs the user to clear space for work, potentially moving an electric range and identifying gas lines.
actions: Check if it is possible to move the electric range.
If possible, slide the electric range out of the way.
Locate any flexible gas lines.
Do not move or disconnect gas lines.
If unable to move the range, leave it in place.
steps.part: Cord sets, flexible gas lines, electric range

steps.description: Inspect the cabinet above the hood and remove light bulbs, covers, and filters to access fasteners.
actions: Inspect the cabinet above the hood
Observe how the cabinet is installed
Remove all light bulbs
Remove covers
Remove filters

steps.description: After removing covers, identify and label the wires within the hood's wiring.
actions: Locate the hood's wiring
Label each wire using a number or identification on masking tape

steps.description: Disconnect wiring by removing connectors and cutting wires with crimped connectors.
actions: Unscrew the wire nuts
Cut off any wires that are using crimped connectors

steps.description: Remove the lock nut securing the cable or conduit within the wiring compartment.
actions: Take the lock nut off of the fitting
Remove the fitting securing the cable or conduit

steps.description: While having someone support the hood, remove all fasteners except for two at opposite ends, which should be loosened but still holding the hood.
actions: Have another person support the hood
Remove all of the fasteners
Leave two screws at opposite ends
Loosen the two screws

steps.description: Remove the final screws and lower the hood with assistance, preparing a space to set it aside.
actions: Remove the final two screws
Pull the hood down
Have an area set aside to place the hood

steps.description: Disconnect the power line from the range hood by loosening a screw and optionally installing a terminal box for safety.
actions: Access connectors and fittings
Remove the power line from the hood
Loosen the screw on the connector from the hood
Install an approved terminal box (optional)
Cap the wires with wire nuts (if terminal box is installed)

steps.description: Restore power to the hood if it was disconnected during the wiring process.
actions: restore power
terminate wires safely
